name: District 7 rally stage and plaza
required_outputs: Nine-panel location sheet: hero wide, north/south/east/west coverage, overhead plan with camera markers, ceiling/floor, fixed props/materials, reverse wide
Separate clean full-resolution 16:9 hero and reverse plates, without grid labels
Annotated overhead layout with fixed door/window/prop coordinates and screen axis
Lighting/material palette and day/night variants only when script needs them
Blank screens and signage areas plus separate exact typography overlays
QC record, source references, prompt, model/version, dimensions and file hash
qa_notes: The rooftop view faces north toward the stage with the tree on the left. It therefore reads as a south-side rooftop, not camera B on the north building looking south; from B the stage building could not appear across the plaza. Correction: Keep the hero and site plan as authority. Do not use this roof view as the specified north/northeast perch; derive the eventual roof scene plate from an agreed joint LOC08/09/20 plan.

The market connection view puts the red-lantern stalls on the right while looking down the market toward the towers. For the established east-looking market axis, the north lantern row should be left. The plaza plan depicts the lantern edge along its east boundary without clearly showing the east-west street continuation. Correction: Annotate the market mouth and north-row continuation on the shared site plan and use LOC08 hero/reverse as authority for market-facing scene plates.

SOUTH is a tight shuttered-shop elevation rather than the requested stage POV across the audience space with west steps. Cardinal labels generally describe facade/content rather than the final camera-side convention. Correction: Treat the shop image as material/elevation reference; label actual viewpoint bearings before blocking. A later stage-POV scene plate must include the open audience area.
Usable rally stage design and plaza hero. Rooftop and market-connection coverage are drafts, not geographically verified scene plates. No regeneration retry requested.
Generated sheets are review drafts, not production-approved camera or geometry masters.
Empty pallet stage, two speakers, center microphone, cherry-blossom steps, adjoining market and rooftop overlook included.
Rooftop image is a useful elevated reverse angle but its shown viewpoint is not exactly the north-roof B position indicated in the plan; fix blocking marks before scene generation.

ownership_note: Production affiliation; not a restriction on which species can appear here.
